outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map combined with western blot images, not a plot showing averaged data.

Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values (% FT depletion, log2 elution abundance) per antibody with no error bars or indication these are averages across replicates, so individual points are not applicable.
Panel C is a heatmap; individual data points are not meaningful in this context and are exempt from the check.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E bar charts explicitly show mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points (circles) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F is a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot where individual points are the data itself; exempt from the check.
Panel H is a scatterplot showing individual IP-MS experiment values directly; exempt from the check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot displaying individual samples directly; exempt from the check.
Panel J consists of PCA scatterplots displaying individual samples directly; exempt from the check.
